description: Detach a connector from a website, app, or agent, ending the grant attach_connector made. The connector itself stays in the organization. A page or agent that still calls it starts getting an error, which is the intended outcome. Detaching a connector that is not attached leaves the same absence. Requires connecting a Valet account.

connector.description: Required. The name the connector is attached under.

name.description: Required. The website's, app's, or agent's name.

org_name.description: The Valet organization both belong to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

name: detach_connector
title: Detach a connector
